mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 77 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 56.

Regarding city news, road work continues for the Aldi development with traffic shifting to maintain flow, and the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is moving forward with upcoming bridge closures planned for mid-September.
There is plenty to do in our area. Today we have the Dane County Farmers Market, as well as live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they received a report concerning a student teacher relationship which led to an arrest on September 4.
Culver's is serving up Mint Cookie as today's flavor of the day and they will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
